id.description: Immutable canonical UUID for this lease, capacity reservation, or customer contract.

schema_version.description: Version of the JSON Schema contract used to validate this record; it changes only through documented repository migrations.

created_at.description: UTC date-time when this repository record was first created; this is audit metadata, not the real-world entity's founding or start date.

modified_at.description: UTC date-time of the latest repository record change; it must be updated whenever a structured value or its provenance changes.

source_ids.description: Non-empty set of Source Document IDs that directly support the observed, estimated, or derived values in this record.

confidence_score.description: Evidence-strength score from 1 (unverified or speculative) to 5 (verified SEC filing), assigned under ASSUMPTIONS.md.

status.description: Current lifecycle classification for the represented entity or record; unknown is used when available evidence does not establish a state.

notes.description: Optional analyst clarification about scope, ambiguity, estimation, or lifecycle context; null means no clarification is recorded and notes never replace structured provenance.

company_id.description: UUID of the infrastructure Company acting as lessor or service provider; foreign key to Company.id.

customer_id.description: UUID of the contractual or disclosed Customer; foreign key to Customer.id.

campus_id.description: Optional UUID of the Campus serving the agreement; foreign key to Campus.id and null when not disclosed or not site-specific.

project_id.description: Optional UUID of the Project serving the agreement; foreign key to Project.id and null when not project-specific.

lease_type.description: Allowed commercial classification describing the principal form of capacity or facility commitment.

contracted_capacity_mw.description: Optional observed contracted power capacity in megawatts; null when the contract has no MW measure or it is undisclosed.

start_date.description: Optional observed or estimated ISO 8601 contractual commencement date; null when unknown or contingent.

end_date.description: Optional observed or derived ISO 8601 contractual expiration date excluding unexercised extensions; null when unknown.

currency.description: Optional ISO 4217 currency for contract_value; null whenever contract_value is null.

contract_value.description: Optional observed or derived non-negative contract value in the adjacent currency; null when undisclosed, and notes or future fact metadata must distinguish nominal from real values.
